_note: Per-user, NON-SECRET config for the Targum.ai agent. Copy this file to config.json and fill in real values. Secrets (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) stay in .env, NOT here. Once config.json exists the agent reads root_folder_id and vault_path from here; the .env keys DRIVE_SOURCE_FOLDER_ID and OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH are now superseded for the agent (the scripts/ bootstrap utility still reads them from .env). spend_cap_usd applies to auth_mode 'api' only — the subscription (SDK) path ignores it, since subscription runs cost no per-token dollars. run_interval_days is the unattended cadence: launchd fires scripts/run_agent.sh daily and the wrapper only runs the agent when this many days have passed since logs/last_run.
